gen-gf-paprika-gf-geist: Paprika scatters its letters wide and lets its lowercase fill the line like capitals, which gives it a loud, hollow-reeded presence. Geist sits beside it in a quiet, level sans with no weight accents, so the two feel like a shout and a murmur.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-georama: Paprika's lowercase swells to capital size, with counters like a cut reed. Georama follows in a plain sans with a bracelet-wide c and barely rising capitals, so the headline gets to show off while the text simply gets on with it.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-gidole: Paprika spaces its letters far apart and fills the line with capital-sized lowercase. Its strongest quality is the gap to Gidole, a plain sans drawn like neon tube with open scissor-blade terminals and a high midline, where everything stays level.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-golos-text: Paprika makes its mark with sprawling, spaced-out letters and lowercase that fills the line like capitals, with tapering strokes. Golos Text does the opposite job, a sans with a full-height x-height and one stroke width, no hairlines anywhere, built for steady reading.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hedvig-letters-sans: That hollow-reed counter and capital-sized lowercase make Paprika loud, with letters scattered at a distance. And Hedvig Letters Sans, a plain sans with a wide gap where the c ends, can take a slightly larger size so its near-capital-tall small letters stay comfortable.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-heebo: Heebo brings a tall central band of text and curves that stop short instead of closing, in a sans-serif that stays out of the way. And Paprika above it spreads its capital-sized lowercase wide, so the page has one loud voice and one quiet one.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads modern and unfussy, a plain sans with tall stamped-metal lowercase and wide gaps between curve ends and stems, with no thick-thin shift. Paragraphs would move along smoothly, never tapering the way Paprika's strokes do.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai reads open and friendly, with sans s curves that gape at both ends and stroke ends that look cut from one ribbon. And Paprika, with its scattered letters and hollow-reed counters, supplies the swagger that this fixed-width router-bit line deliberately lacks.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-mysuru: Paprika stretches its letters apart, with lowercase as big as capitals. Hind Mysuru runs a long stretch smoothly, a sans whose lowercase tops press near the ascender height, strokes traced like marker with no calligraphic thinning, and each a left slightly ajar.
gen-gf-paprika-gf-hind-siliguri: Scattered letters and counters like a cut reed make Paprika's lowercase swell to capital size. Hind Siliguri, a sans-serif with cracked-bangle rounds and a flat gray hum of constant line weight, steadies the page while Paprika does the talking.
